Package hec.rss.model

Interface ZoneObject

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConditionalBlockRef, OpRuleRef
public interface ZoneObject
Interface for operating rule related objects held by StorageZones. Classes implmenting this interface include OpRuleRef and ConditionalBlockRef.
